name: GEEETECH (Shenzhen Getech Technology Co., Ltd.)
summary: Shenzhen 3D printing manufacturer founded in 2013, one of the earliest Chinese open-source printer companies. It builds its own FDM printers, filament dryers and build surfaces alongside a broad filament range, and acts as an upstream OEM producing filament for the TEQStone, XZN and Giantarm labels (project-owner verified).

oem_relationships.notes: User-verified (research/verified-oem-relationships.md). TEQStone is a retail label with no independent manufacturing presence and so has no entry of its own; not mentioned on Geeetech's own pages.
User-verified (research/verified-oem-relationships.md). XZN is a retail label with no independent manufacturing presence and so has no entry of its own; not mentioned on Geeetech's own pages.
User-verified (research/verified-oem-relationships.md). Giantarm is a retail label with no independent manufacturing presence and so has no entry of its own; not mentioned on Geeetech's own pages.

product_lines.name: PLA
product_lines.notes: Plain PLA; wiki describes it as made from natural materials such as corn starch.

product_lines.name: PLA Silk (incl. Dual Color, Tri-Color, Rainbow)
product_lines.notes: PLA base with 'elastic additives' producing the silk/glossy finish; multi-colour variants are spool features.

product_lines.name: PLA Marble
product_lines.notes: PLA 'mixed with stone powder or other additives to simulate marble'. No marble/stone-filled PLA id exists (see gaps).

product_lines.name: PLA Wood
product_lines.notes: Quantified composite: about 85% PLA / 15% wood fibre per the Geeetech wiki.

product_lines.name: Carbon Fiber PLA
product_lines.notes: PLA plus carbon fibre, documented on the wiki but not currently in the main storefront category list - possibly legacy or a limited SKU.

product_lines.name: High Speed PLA
product_lines.notes: PLA reformulated for optimised melt index/Tg for faster flow; process delta only.

product_lines.name: PETG Metal
product_lines.notes: Metallic-pigment PETG. Base resin is PETG; the catalog has no metallic/metal-filled PETG id (see gaps).

product_lines.name: ABS+
product_lines.notes: Impact-enhanced ABS on the standard ABS chemistry.

product_lines.name: TPU
product_lines.notes: Shore 95A confirmed on the Geeetech wiki.

additional_notes: Legal entity Shenzhen Getech Technology Co., Ltd. Sells PEI sheets (including Bambu Lab A1 Mini-compatible sizes), magnetic flexible plates, tempered glass beds and bed adhesive, for both its own and third-party printers; no plate_ids are asserted since no plate entries exist for them. Also manufactures FDM printers (Mizar S, Mizar M, Thunder) and the D1 filament dryer. Scale claims of 'millions of printers' and '1M+ users in 100+ countries' are self-reported marketing. Instagram, TikTok, X and LinkedIn links appear in the site footer but exact handles were not individually verified, so they are omitted from endpoints.social.

provenance.conflicts: The TEQStone/XZN/Giantarm OEM relationships are owner-verified but have no public corroboration: Geeetech's about-us page makes no mention of private-label or OEM business. They are consistent with its scale as a vertically integrated Shenzhen manufacturer but remain unconfirmed via open web, and whether Geeetech extrudes all its own filament or subcontracts any of it was not established.
